name: network.prokura/authority
title: Prokura Authority
description: Power of attorney for AI agents: a no-LLM gate checks each payment against a human-signed mandate.

tools.name: prokura_request_mandate
tools.description: Ask a human to grant this session a 10-minute demo Prokura Credential. 100.00 EUR per payment, step-up above 50.00 EUR, 150.00 EUR per day. Returns a grant URL and a QR code. Never returns a mandate. Any scope, principal or amount you send is ignored.

tools.name: prokura_check
tools.description: Ask the policy gate whether a payment would be allowed. Nothing is paid.

mandateId.description: Optional in a demo session: the mandate this session was granted is used

amount.description: Decimal amount with two digits, e.g. "890.00"

purpose.description: Purpose code allowed by the mandate, e.g. saas_renewal

invoice.description: Invoice number or text; hashed into invoiceHash if invoiceHash is not given

agent_name.description: Optional self-declared name of this agent (at most 64 characters). Stored with the evidence and shown publicly as self-declared, never verified.

tools.name: prokura_pay
tools.description: Submit a payment. The policy gate decides allow, step_up (a human approves with a passkey) or deny; only allowed payments are executed, server-side. Give either amount + payee + purpose, or, for an HTTP 402 API, x402Url (the paid response is returned).

mandateId.description: Optional in a demo session: the mandate this session was granted is used

amount.description: Decimal amount with two digits, e.g. "890.00"

purpose.description: Purpose code allowed by the mandate, e.g. saas_renewal

invoice.description: Invoice number or text; hashed into invoiceHash if invoiceHash is not given

agent_name.description: Optional self-declared name of this agent (at most 64 characters). Stored with the evidence and shown publicly as self-declared, never verified.

x402Url.description: Pay for an HTTP 402 resource: amount, payee and rail are read from its challenge. Give either x402Url, or amount + payee + purpose.

tools.name: prokura_evidence
tools.description: Fetch an evidence record by id, or all records of a mandate.

tools.name: prokura_mandate
tools.description: Read a mandate's current state: whether it is active, revoked, expired or not yet valid; its validity window; its scope (currency, per-payment cap, step-up threshold, period cap, allowed rails and purposes, payees); and the budget used so far in the current period (budget, spent, remaining). Use it to learn what the agent may still spend before calling prokura_check or prokura_pay. It only reads: it does not call the gate, spend budget or write evidence. It does not issue or renew a mandate (use prokura_request_mandate for that) and does not list payment history (use prokura_evidence). The summary is redacted for callers that do not own the mandate: the principal's legal name is left out and payees are returned as a count. In a demo session, if the human has not yet approved the grant, it answers with an error (grant_required, grant_pending or grant_expired) instead of a summary, and an id other than the session's own mandate is refused with mandate_not_in_session.

mandateId.description: Mandate (credential) id, as returned when a grant was approved or a mandate was issued, e.g. 01JC0000000000000000000001. In a demo session you may leave it out: the mandate this session was granted is used; any other id is refused.

tools.name: store_catalog
tools.description: List the 4 items of Prokura's fake demo store, each with sku, name, unit price (amount and currency EUR), payee (a demo domain: demo-store.prokura.network, demo-saas.prokura.network, demo-travel.prokura.network), purpose (software or travel) and rail (mollie, test mode). Call it first to learn which skus exist and which payee and purpose belong to each, then use store_quote to price a quantity, and pass the payee, purpose and amount to prokura_check (dry run) or prokura_pay. Takes no arguments, is read-only, needs no mandate or session grant, and never moves money; the catalog is fixed demo data. A catalog line is not a gate decision: the gate (prokura_check, prokura_pay) alone decides allow, step_up or deny.

tools.name: store_quote
tools.description: Price one item of the fake demo store: returns the item (sku, name, payee, purpose, rail mollie), the quantity, the currency (EUR) and the total amount as a decimal string with two digits, e.g. "29.00" for one saas-seat. Use it after store_catalog, to turn a sku and quantity into the exact amount, payee and purpose to put into prokura_check (dry run) or prokura_pay. Read-only: it creates no order and reserves nothing, needs no mandate or session grant, and moves no money. An unknown sku, or a quantity outside 1 to 10, returns an error result. A quote is not a gate decision: only prokura_check and prokura_pay decide allow, step_up or deny, so a quote above the mandate's limits can still be denied.

sku.description: Catalog item id, exactly as store_catalog lists it: "field-notebook", "saas-seat", "rail-pass", "workstation". An unknown sku returns an unknown_sku error.

quantity.description: How many units to price, a whole number from 1 to 10. Optional, defaults to 1. The amount is the unit price times quantity.
